def solution():
    # Define variables
    beginning_value = 100
    ending_value = 370.32
    holding_period_years = 5

    # Calculate the annualized return (CAGR)
    annualized_return = (
        (ending_value / beginning_value) ** (1 / holding_period_years) - 1
    ) * 100

    # Return the result rounded to the nearest integer
    answer = round(annualized_return)
    return answer
